name: Мікс: мат
description:
In chess, you win by checkmating your opponent. You can also just call checkmate 'mate'. It's nice and short.


When is it checkmate?

  • The king is in check. Another player's piece threatens to capture the king.
  • The king cannot move.
  • The piece that checks cannot be captured.
  • No other piece can be put between the king and the attacker. So defending is impossible.


What should you do?

Checkmate your opponent in one move.

texts: Check the king and ensure it has no escape squares. That's checkmate!
